notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png[/img]

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

[b]Cypress Reel
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png[/img]

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

[b]Story mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg[/img]

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

[b]Invasion mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg[/img]

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

[b]Raid mode
[/b]

This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b], Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

[b]Mini-games
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg[/img]

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

[h1]Patch 3[/h1]
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

[h1]Patch 2[/h1]
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

notes.notes:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910430409][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/297f215cca7de123581d3b369d7eca0809c89132.png[/img][/url]
Hey Survivors! We're back again for another weekly update!

[h1]Outbreak: The New Nightmare Updates[/h1]
After our launch on Steam Greenlight a few weeks back, development on Outbreak: The New Nightmare has continued at break neck speeds! Let's take a quick look and don't forget to vote for us on Steam Greenlight (and tell your friends)!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910430409][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/b0784cd19a7dc4a2cc0fe8080d969f7e3f5f8b31.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Updated Demo Playthrough Trailer[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTcEiSMO22s]Check out the updated demo playthrough trailer and see all of the enhancements for yourself![/url]

[h1]What's the release plan for Outbreak: The New Nightmare?[/h1]
We're happy to announce that our plans for releasing O:TNN is to release on Steam Early Access as soon as we're able. Our plan is to develop this title fully with community feedback and ensure that this game becomes the best it can be. Once we've cleared Steam Greenlight, we'll provide more information about an anticipated release date. The goal is to make the initial offering meaty and then continue to add content, enhancements and fixes over time until it reaches a point where we can have a full release. Keep sharing the Greenlight page with your friends! We appreciate the support!

[h1]The Cast[/h1]
The first four survivors of Outbreak: The New Nightmare have been announced! Right now in the pre-alpha build, they have many of the traits of the original four survivors from Outbreak. Expect these to get remixed in new ways before release, but this is just a preview of the beginning of the cast!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/2ae73e5ab215a49bf3b293c60572b7adaa5d41e7.png[/img]
[h1]Gore and Explosions[/h1]
Outbreak: The New Nightmare has been going through significant graphical polishing, including an all new particle blood system and meaty explosions! You'll feel the full force of the gory apocalypse when you land hits or launch a grenade round into a crowd of the undead!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/94ceb8c595619bc59b5fd4917c38a0b18c329cb6.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/c70f10dd15c8b45cc316cfe7c59fea71bcb37f25.jpg[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer - The Heart of the Experience[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/7c3f9f81479fe796fd469cfdbd899100586ff7dd.jpg[/img]
We're happy to announce that multiplayer is now fully implemented in our pre-alpha build for all of the supported game functionality. This is a major step and we were fortunately able to reuse a lot of infrastructure from the original Outbreak to propel progress forward! Keep an eye out for a multiplayer video sometime in the next week or so!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/eb1d513f9b762217649f23a48c9431bb3cdb11b5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey, what about those Xbox One and Windows Store ports of Outbreak?[/h1]
We're still working on releasing those ports and are actively trying to get them out as soon as possible. No rough ETA just yet, but we'll update as soon as we know more about a definitive release date.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you again for continuing to play and support the Outbreak series. We're very excited about showing off new features, levels, enhancements and much more! Keep telling your friends!

notes.title: Outbreak Weekend Dev Update
notes.notes:

Checking with the regular weekly update on Outbreak happenings!

[h1]Outbreak is now available at a lower price![/h1]
Earlier this week, we permanently reduced the price of Outbreak by about 33% (~$9.99 USD, but will vary in other currencies). Those versions will be a bit different from the Steam release and this price change is intended to bring us into sync with those platforms.

[h1]So what's happening with the Xbox One and Windows Store ports?[/h1]
All of the development time in the last week has been focused on finishing those ports and getting them into shape to release on these platforms. We're hard at work with Microsoft to get the final polish in place, then get approval for release. You'll be earning Xbox Live achievements in no time, so stay tuned!

[h1]And just one more tease...[/h1]
We're also very hard at work on a special surprise, but it's still a ways out. We won't say anything to spoil it, but when it gets revealed we think you'll be very pleased. The most exciting days for Outbreak are still ahead of us!

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Have a great week and keep sharing Outbreak with your friends! It's been great to see the hundreds of new players in the last few weeks! Thanks again for supporting the game!

notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

It's time for another weekend dev update, where I'll give you some behind-the-scenes look on Outbreak! I'll also catch you up on some releases from the last week!

[h1]Weekly Community Survival Sessions[/h1]
[b]We're hosting community playdates EVERY Saturday at 8PM EST![/b] Hop online and watch the stream or jump in multiplayer for a chance to play with the developer! Let's try to use this as a regular time to help the community get together to play some co-op! The stream will be available in the Community Hub under Broadcasts.

[h1]Single Player Demo Now Available! (Free)[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/fe5c61637b1589fb001b09184665a2a1bf11ee39.png[/img]
We've just launched a free single-player demo for Outbreak! You'll have the opportunity to play through the "Tutorial" campaign scenario. Once you're familiar with the game mechanics, you can jump into the first part of the "Captive" Nightmares scenario.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/ac2cb262552825432f2e20399b2cab6fcaa52f2d.jpg[/img]
The demo provides a small slice of gameplay and gives you an opportunity to try out all of the different control schemes. You can fully customize your keyboard, mouse & gamepad controls in the demo as well! Check it out and let us know what you think on the message boards!

[h1]"Care" - Nightmares scenario released! (Free)[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/a5d5882817b2b0af990735060f38d431f94bbbe5.jpg[/img]
The latest Nightmares scenario, "Care", has been released! You'll take on the role of Ethan as he's busy working on his doctoral thesis (or... maybe playing some video games...). He hears a strange noise down the hallway and goes to investigate. As he attempts to survive this nightmare, he'll have to protect Nora (an unarmed NPC). Good luck surviving the undead threats as the lyceum burns to the ground around you!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/ca361cba6e263d13218ff51b69fdffff7aa05492.jpg[/img]

We've recently pushed a new patch to reduce the frequency (and the amount of concurrent) monster spawns across the game. "Biohazard" mode is designed to be completely unfair and brutal.

Starting with a group of fellow police officers, you'll be investigating the situation and searching for survivors. But, as the story always goes, something goes horribly wrong...

Clear is going to be designed to be a more "action"-based scenario. You're going in fully armed... but how long will this preparation last? "Clear" will be releasing in the next few weeks.

[h1]Port to Xbox One and Windows Store Progress[/h1]
The ports continue to truck along. This week saw additional polish to the Windows Store version of Outbreak as I work towards meeting Xbox Live platform requirements. There is still no ETA for this version, it's likely a few months out.

The Xbox One version hasn't had appreciable progress this week. It'll be on the back burner for the time being until the Windows Store version is complete. Again, there is no ETA for the Xbox One version but we'll keep trying to make it during 2017!

Thank you for continuing to play and support Outbreak! Keep the feedback coming and post your videos, screenshots and artwork to the game hub. [b]If you've purchased Outbreak and enjoyed your experience, a positive Steam Review is greatly appeciated![/b]

notes.title: Weekend Dev Update 3/5/2017
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

There has been a flurry of progress on Outbreak following our second free, large content drop from a week ago. Let's take a look at what's happening behind the scenes.

[h1]Nightmares - New Scenario "Care" (Free)[/h1]
The second Nightmares scenario is under development and it's entitled "Care". In this scenario, you'll take control of Ethan who is busy working on his doctoral studies (but also may have been playing video games...). He gets up as he hears a scream down the hallway.

You'll find yourself exploring the Lyceum in the midst of an Outbreak. During your travels, you'll be joined by Nora. One of the unique aspects of this scenario is that Nora is unarmed and you'll need to protect her. If she dies, it's game over. You'll have to guide both characters to safety as the Lyceum is overrun with undead and slowly burns to the ground.

Don't worry. Even though Nora can't fight, she is very tough (at least in Normal difficulty...). Interested to see if folks can survive on Biohazard and keep both characters intact. This next scenario doesn't have an ETA, but will likely show up in a week or two...

[h1]Xbox One and Windows Store Ports[/h1]
I've spent the first month since Outbreak has been out actively focusing on boosting content and getting community feedback integrated. As the game stabilizes, it's now time to put effort into porting it to new platforms. Xbox One and Windows Store are great future platforms for Outbreak. One of the things I'm looking forward to the most is grabbing some achievements for my Xbox Live profile! ːsteamhappyː

The Xbox One port is coming along very well. Virtually all functionality (including Xbox Live integration) is finished excluding multiplayer. It still needs thorough testing and edge cases, but the progress has been sizable in the last few weeks. I still don't have even a vague ETA for a release date. Integrating multiplayer will take a bit due to the third party services Outbreak uses. But I still feel the game is on track for a 2017 launch.

The Windows Store port is also coming along very well. The entire game, including multiplayer, is now playable completely. In addition, basic Xbox Live services have been integrated such as profile sign in, stats and achievements. The next step for this port is extensive testing and then working through certification. I would imagine this port is a few months out right now, but hopefully it will come along sooner.

[h1]What kind of fixes can we expect in the next patch?[/h1]
The next patch should be addressing the following game issues:
[list]
    [*]Additional player health buffs in multiplayer games. 2-player games now have health buffs very similar to playing in single-player mode.
    [*]The character selection and starting equipment screens will now update the menu properly when mouse hovering over selections.
    [*]Other small fixes and very minor enhancements.
[/list]

[h1]New Control Scheme - Action Mouse Hybrid[/h1]
We released a very small minor patch a few days back that added a new control scheme - [b]Action Mouse Hybrid[/b]. This control scheme allows you to control your character's movement like the [b]Action[/b] control scheme using your keyboard keys. But when you aim, control switches to the mouse and your character will face the mouse position. This creates an awesome 2D shooter control scheme, so definitely check it out!

[b]You can change your control scheme in the Options menu under Player options[/b]. Remember! You can change your controls in-game as well. Use F1 or the Start button on your gamepad to access the options menu!

[h1]Community Playdates[/h1]
I'm still working to find an appropriate time and way to organize regular community playdates to help everyone get a chance to try out the multiplayer. I should have more news on this in the next week or so. I also have some upcoming work getting put into some community growth, which you'll hear about in the next 3 weeks or so. The community is definitely growing and on a steady upswing. Keep telling friends about the game and encouraging them to play!

[h1]Thank you for supporting Outbreak![/h1]
Thank you again for playing and following Outbreak. Don't be shy about posting feedback and suggestions in the forums! Keep telling your friends about the game and posting about it on social media! The community is growing strong! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Weekend Dev Update! - AI Partner / Nightmares Narrative Mode
notes.notes:
As the long holiday weekend draws to a close, I'd just like to share some recent work!

[h1]Nightmares[/h1]
Nightmares is a new narrative single-player experience that revisits locations from the campaign and provides short non-canon side-stories within them that do not relate to the main campaign mode. In Nightmares, your scenario will dictate the character you play as. Their abilities may also be slightly remixed to help improve the experience. Enemies and other events will be different.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/e7fe3814fa566c1d34a2ccbe09a01f2abb0f75bc.jpg[/img]
Nightmares is intended to be a slower-paced classic survival horror experience. Features like pausing in any UI are always enforced and enabled. In addition, the endless hordes are disabled and a greater focus on set-piece enemies and encounters. The addition of the AI partner system (see below) and other neat tricks will allow it to be a more strategically paced experience.

The plan is to release Nightmares as episodic content over time. The first episode's release doesn't have a release date and won't be in the incoming content drop, but we'll keep you posted as they come along.

[h1]AI Partner[/h1]
One of the largest requests coming out of the community has been for supporting AI teammates. Our upcoming content drop & patch (which is hopefully dropping in the next week or two) will include initial, limited support.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/28c1a0c2a2e1582be864175fecf7a2416daaf969.png[/img]
In single-player Campaign and Onslaught, you will now be able to toggle an option to provide an AI teammate or not. In the initial release, this teammate will follow your player and attack incoming threats.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/53d3f564ca9bcc5a33b42d0f94e00ce3d07ddfc4.jpg[/img]
You won't be able to manage their inventory, so there are a few small changes made to support the experience. AI teammates will have unlimited ammo, but they will deal significantly less damage than other players. They also will need to reload like anyone else.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/7776a63c76d21a1bb0c634b6c28e11c7d56999d6.jpg[/img]
To help keep them alive, they will have buffed health compared to the average player. They will also slowly heal over time. They can help create a great diversion, but at the end of the day, you're responsible for supporting them and keeping them alive. If they die during the scenario, they're out for good. You can always choose to play solo and experience the classic Outbreak experience as it's always been! The choice is yours!

[h1]When will more content drop?[/h1]
We're working on designing and building the new character and enemies. The hope is to release the next free content drop in the next week or two. Nightmares is targeted a bit further off and we'll have more information as the game continues. The content drop will also have a patch with a few big fixes like Quies's inventory glitching text with melee weapons and improved gamepad consistency in the UI system.

Thanks for supporting Outbreak!

They can help create a great diversion, but at the end of the day, you're responsible for supporting them and keeping them alive. If they die during the scenario, they're out for good. You can always choose to play solo and experience the classic Outbreak experience as it's always been! The choice is yours!

[h1]When will more content drop?[/h1]
We're working on designing and building the new character and enemies. The hope is to release the next free content drop in the next week or two. Nightmares is targeted a bit further off and we'll have more information as the game continues. The content drop will also have a patch with a few big fixes like Quies's inventory glitching text with melee weapons and improved gamepad consistency in the UI system.

Thanks for supporting Outbreak!

notes.title: Outbreak Dev Weekly Update
notes.notes:
As the work week draws to a close, I thought it'd be great to check in on some of the progress happening behind on the scenes on the game.

[h1]The Next Free Content Drop[/h1]
I'm very busy generating some new content for the next release. My hope is for the next content drop to include a [b]new character, some new enemies and an Onslaught scenario or two[/b].

One of the scenarios not yet reflected in Onslaught mode is the Outbreak scenario. There are some notable areas, such as the Garage and Primary Triage. I'm working to find good ways to adapt these zones for the Onslaught experience.

The [b]Garage[/b] will be an interesting scenario. Since it's rectangular with no hallways, it creates a unique take on Onslaught where camping a hallway becomes more difficult. Will you be able to survive 30 waves or more with enemies closing in from all angles?

[b]Primary Triage[/b] is also a unique zone. Featuring the small food court, a few patient rooms and the advanced lab section, it'll provide some tight hallways and open areas to battle the horde. 

We'll have more to reveal about the new enemies and new character a little bit further down the road. The plan is to make [b]all of this content free[/b] for everyone. Expect this content to drop in the next few weeks.

[h1]Console Port[/h1]
I've also been hard at work on the Xbox One version of Outbreak. It's been a whirlwind of development as the game is now in a state where single player is accessible with the majority of features. Some major areas that will be under heavy development in the coming months is integrating Xbox services and getting multiplayer up and running.

The Xbox One version is still quite a ways off, but I remain optimistic we'll be seeing it sometime in 2017.

[h1]Spreading the Outbreak Community[/h1]
Thank you to everyone in the community who has been providing feedback, both in the forums and on Steam reviews. [b]If you've purchased and enjoyed Outbreak, a positive Steam review is greatly appreciated![/b] If you have any feedback, please don't hesitate to post on the forums so we have a chance to meet your expectations. We want to make Outbreak great for everyone!

notes.title: Outbreak Release - Jan 17th, 2017!
notes.notes:
[b]The apocalypse draws near... Are you ready?[/b]

[h1]Release Date for Steam (Windows)[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/4b58e67e89958eb2e7c7a2eebf015b71c9261e92.jpg[/img]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=840023346]Check out the Outbreak Launch Trailer![/url]

Outbreak's Steam release is set for [b]January 17th, 2017[/b]! We have decided to pursue a [b]full release[/b] instead of early access after evaluating the game in the final months of development. [b]Outbreak will also feature a substantial launch discount for the first week after release![/b]

Outbreak is launching with a swath of content including the campaign and onslaught modes. Every mode in Outbreak is playable [b]with up to four-player online co-op[/b] and [b]offline in single-player mode[/b]. In all modes [b]you only have a single life[/b]. If you die, it's all over and the rest of your team is on their own.

[b]Campaign[/b] follows the story of four survivors trapped in a hospital during a viral outbreak. The hospital has been overrun with hordes of mutated undead creatures. The survivors must methodically work through different areas, scrounge for supplies, fight off their persuers and try to find a way to escape. It's a brutal, unforgiving experience that scales up with multiple difficulty modes and based on the number of players in the game. With few supplies and an endless horde, you'll need to keep moving at all costs to survive!

[b]Onslaught[/b] drops the horror of the campaign and trades it for all out action. The survivors must fight off endless waves of increasingly difficult monsters. When they slay monsters or clear waves, they will accumulate credits that can be spent on new weapons and equipment. Credits can also be spent to buy keycards and unlock more of the level, which will lead to increasingly better equipment.

[h1]Xbox One and Windows Store Ports - Much Later in 2017[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/e911aeb0ef81c72454c5da05166a80f748fb034f.jpg[/img]
We're also happy to announce that Outbreak will be coming to Xbox One and Windows Store [b]much later[/b] in 2017! The Xbox One version will be a native game for Xbox One and will integrate Xbox Live functionality including achievements! The Windows Store version will be a UWP application. We'll have more news on these versions much later in 2017 as development is just getting underway. Any fixes or enhancements to the Steam version of Outbreak (outside of Steam-specific functionality) will be included in those ports when they release, so play it on Steam and send us feedback!

[h1]Let's Talk Multiplayer![/h1]
Outbreak [b]does not use P2P connections[/b] for multiplayer gameplay. It utilizes a robust cloud-backend with region support that is nearly worldwide. When you start up Outbreak, it will automatically connect to the region with the best ping. 

You can [b]override your region[/b] in the [b]Options Menu[/b]. You [b]must be on the same region as your friends[/b] to play together, so make sure to square that away first! Although each game will have a "host", all players (including the host) will be communicating with this backend service and not eachother directly. [b]This means you should have virtually no NAT/Firewall punchthrough issues when trying to play with friends![/b] The host does has elevated abilities to kick people from the game and return the group to the lobby at will though, so you can keep games under control.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/91e13cc47ec6a4fa6c2463a68086614f20e2923a.jpg[/img]
[b]Playing with friends is easy![/b] Just make sure you're all on the same region, enter a custom name for your game and start a private server. Your friends can then join via your server name (so make it easy to type or just paste it!). Once you have all of your friends in the game, simply make it public and other folks will join! Games can only be joined when you're in the room lobby.

Playing with strangers is just as easy! Either start up a public server or use the server browser and filtering options to find a game. You can mute voice chat from other players at any time as well (including yourself!).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/821a8c516fd238fe7b200ca361482d10b1f14ae9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Outbreak - The Official Guide[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/74ec7e0dc9da74f652aeb5445098f92a37ac1361.jpg[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=830900567]Dead Drop Studios is building an official guide on Outbreak[/url]. It contains in-depth information about many aspects of the game, including the menu system, game mechanics, achievements and tons of other areas. Many common questions and issues are answered directly in the guide. Check it out and let us know about any new content you'd like to see in it!

Keep an eye on the Outbreak announcement section, [url=http://www.outbreakzone]the Outbreak website[/url] and our [url=https://twitter.com/Outbreak_Zone]Twitter page[/url] for up-to-date information! We're very excited to share and play Outbreak with you. Keep telling your friends!
